Also they opened other types of invoices (maybe "机动车销售统一发票" which is a type of invoice for vehicle sales). So we can label as "虚开增值税专用发票;虚开普通发票". However examples sometimes combine: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". They include "用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" as part of same label. In our case, they didn't mention export tax, just defrauding tax. So maybe just "虚开增值税专用发票". And also "虚开普通发票". Let's see if any example includes both: Not directly. But we can output both separated by semicolon.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票;虚开普通发票<eoa>
